verdict.rationale: Devin indexes repositories so it can understand the codebase without manual context selection, and this powers Ask Devin and DeepWiki. DeepWiki auto-generates documentation for navigating architecture and code, and Ask Devin answers questions about code structure and dependencies. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that DeepWiki and Ask Devin map large unfamiliar codebases accurately, and in-depth first-party detail on indexing scope and limits.
